# anti-slop-pr

> A deterministic reference resolver for AI-written PR descriptions. It checks
> whether the file / test / source-card / issue / commit references a PR body
> cites actually RESOLVE against the repo. It does NOT verify correctness,
> relevance, support, source truth, advice quality, reasoning, or canon — it is a
> checker, not a judge. Stdlib only; no model, network, GitHub API, or token.

## Install it (for agents)

- [INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md](INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md): the full install-and-wire-CI protocol.
- One-line user prompt: "Install anti-slop-pr in this repo, run the smoke, add report-mode CI, and open a PR."

Exact commands:
- Install: `pip install "anti-slop-lineage @ git+https://github.com/nferna26/anti-slop"`
- Self-test: `anti-slop-pr --self-test` and `anti-slop-pr-event --self-test`
- Check a PR body: `anti-slop-pr --root . <pr-body.md>`  (add `--report` for advisory)
- GitHub Actions: copy `templates/anti-slop-pr.yml` → `.github/workflows/` (report mode; drop `--report` to enforce)

## Reference

- [docs/pr-provenance.md](docs/pr-provenance.md): usage, tiers, ignore directives, "First 60 seconds", GitHub Actions recipe.
- [docs/citation-lineage-gate.md](docs/citation-lineage-gate.md): the reused source-card/source resolver (the one benchmark-backed primitive).
- [README.md](README.md): the Anti-Slop books-kb this tool came out of.

## Tiers (deterministic vs advisory)

- Deterministic (hard fail): file refs (path-like), test nodes, source-card/source refs.
- Advisory (never fails): issue refs without a registry; commit-SHA refs.
- Default adoption is report mode; blocking enforcement is explicit opt-in.
